title: 第十六章：歇斯底里（下）
content_zh:
“砰•••砰砰•••”贺峰的心不由得狂跳了起来，他明白能让这么多人这么惊讶，在众人心中能有这么高的地位，那么突然出现的这个人必定是一个“贵人”。好像是为了证明贺峰心中的想法，正在一旁为金钟、金道、韦明三人救治的裁判组，突然来到了人群前，单膝跪地，除此之外，再无多余的话语，更再也没有多余的动作。

    “砰砰•••砰砰•••”贺峰的心跳不觉间又加快了几分，要知道金家、韦家、云家、李家、贺家，或许单独一家在武朝上下，只能算是一个末流小家族，但若是几家结合在一起的话，就算比起武朝那些鼎鼎大名的二流家族，也是不遑多让。如此阵容，那些依然泰然自若，淡然处之的古拉见习裁判组，而现在却只是听到了声音，便恭敬的跪地迎接，似乎哪怕是有百分之九十九认错人的可能，他们也会拿出百分之百的恭敬一般。这让贺峰更加笃定来的这个人的身份非同寻常。

    但现在，对贺峰来说又是一个绝佳的机会，他本来就很愁苦，不知道怎样才能和李纯一起全身而退，但现在所有的人的目光和心思都被那个还没见到人影的人吸引了，如果在这时候他把金灿和云鸿飞达到的话••••••，但后果也可能是，若是引得那个贵人的反感，会不会牵连到自己的家族？甚至牵连李家与聂家？！

    这个后果太过严重，贺峰不得不谨慎衡量，贺峰的呼吸都有些急促了，心中烦闷不已，就在这时，他突然想到，自己现在只是一个不到两岁的孩子，顶多事后表现出一副愣头青的模样，想必也不会有人会跟一个两岁不到的小孩子计较什么吧，更何况一个贵人呢？

    深吸一口气，握紧了拳头，快速的集结着力量，时间确实很紧迫，若是等贵人现身，自己就彻底失去了场面的控制权。

    前面就说过，贺峰虽然混混沌沌的吃睡了差不多一年的时间，但他的身体强度比起韦明也是犹有胜之，而力气更是之比金灿差上一丝半线，凭借他前世三十多年的经验，他又把握在金灿猝不及防之时，让金灿倒地不起，但若是等他反应过来，以现在贺峰的状态，有七成的可能是自己会被揍的亲妈都不敢认自己，这也是贺峰敢动手的最重要的原因之一。

    这时，贺峰却被一只手拉住了自己的手腕，扭头一看，却是李纯冲他摇了摇头，显然，中间的利害关系，他也想得明白，不想要贺峰冒这个险，贺峰无声的点了点头，将自己的手抽了出来。

    贺峰搭弓引箭，现在拉弓如满月，已是不得不发，猛地抬头看向了站在李纯前方的金灿，而同时，金灿也是猛地一瞪眼，望向了贺峰。

    动了！动了！动了！仿佛是听到了战鼓声的士兵，犹如之前演练过千百回的挚友一般，四个人，四道身影，在这一个瞬间，全部都动了起来！

    贺峰双脚用力一登，犹如出膛的子弹，直线攻向金灿的肋下，前面讲过，猛然全力爆发的贺峰就算是金灿恐怕也只能暂避锋芒；而金灿却也正好攻向了贺峰，用的依然是腿，早就听闻，金家炼体功法中，尤以腿功最为刚猛狠辣，虽然明知道现在的金灿哪怕连形都未必能够领会，但却也容不得贺峰小视；李纯用的却并不是什么功法，而是肩扛，身宽体重的他，猛然横身一跳，向着金灿扛了过去，这一击若中，也是够金灿倒地不起的；而云鸿飞也是丝毫不弱，用的是肘击，在人体攻击之中，肘击的综合杀伤力绝对能够排进前三，一跃而下，目标正是贺峰。
content_en:
"Bang•••Bang Bang•••" He Feng's heart couldn't help but beat wildly. He understood that to be so surprised by so many people and to have such a high status in everyone's hearts, the person who suddenly appeared must be a "noble person". As if to prove He Feng's thoughts, the referee team who was treating Jin Zhong, Jin Dao, and Wei Ming suddenly came to the crowd and knelt down on one knee. Apart from that, there were no more unnecessary words or actions.

    "Bang Bang•••Bang Bang•••" He Feng's heartbeat speeded up a bit unknowingly. You must know that the Jin family, the Wei family, the Yun family, the Li family, the He family, perhaps alone in the Wu Dynasty, can only be regarded as a low-ranking small family, but if several families are combined together, even compared to the famous second-rate families of the Wu Dynasty, they will not be far behind. With such a lineup, those Gula trainee referees who were still calm and indifferent now just heard the voice and knelt down to greet him respectfully. It seemed that even if there was a 99% chance of admitting the wrong person, they would show 100% respect. This made He Feng even more certain that the identity of the person who came was extraordinary.

    But now, it is another excellent opportunity for He Feng. He was already very sad and didn't know how to escape with Li Chun, but now everyone's eyes and minds are attracted to the person who has not yet seen the figure. If he reaches Jin Can and Yun Hongfei at this time..., but the consequences may also be that if he arouses the resentment of that noble man, will his family be implicated? Even involve the Li family and the Nie family? !

    This consequence was too serious, and He Feng had to weigh it carefully. He Feng's breathing was a little rapid, and he was very upset. At this moment, he suddenly thought that he was just a child under two years old. At most, he would look stunned afterwards. No one would care about a child under two years old, let alone a noble person?

    He took a deep breath, clenched his fists, and quickly gathered his strength. Time was indeed very tight. If he waited for the noble man to show up, he would completely lose control of the scene.

    As mentioned before, although He Feng has been eating and sleeping in a chaotic manner for almost a year, his physical strength is still superior to Wei Ming, and his strength is even less than that of Jin Can. With more than thirty years of experience in his previous life, he has When Jin Can was caught off guard, Jin Can fell to the ground, but if he had waited for him to react, with He Feng's current state, there was a 70% chance that he would be beaten and his own mother would not dare to recognize him. This was one of the most important reasons why He Feng dared to take action.

    At this time, He Feng was pulled by a hand on his wrist. When he turned around, it was Li Chun who shook his head at him. Obviously, he also understood the stakes involved and did not want He Feng to take the risk. He Feng nodded silently and took out his hand.

    He Feng nocked the bow and drew the arrow. Now he was drawing the bow like a full moon and had no choice but to fire it. He suddenly raised his head and looked at Jin Can, who was standing in front of Li Chun. At the same time, Jin Can also glared at He Feng.

    It's moving! It's moving! It's moving! As if they were soldiers who heard the sound of war drums, like close friends who had practiced thousands of times before, four people, four figures, all moved at this moment!

    He Feng stepped forward with both feet, like a bullet from the barrel, attacking Jin Can's ribs in a straight line. As mentioned before, even Jin Can could only dodge the sharp blow from He Feng who burst out with all his strength; but Jin Can also attacked He Feng just in time, still using his legs. He had long heard that among the Jin family's body-training techniques, leg skills are the most powerful and fierce, although he knew that the current Jin Can might not be able to understand even if he was still in shape. But there was no room for He Feng to look down on him; Li Chun did not use any technique, but carried it on his shoulders. With his broad body and heavy weight, he suddenly jumped sideways and carried it towards Jin Can. If the hit hit, it would be enough for Jin Can to fall to the ground; and Yun Hongfei was not weak at all, using an elbow attack. Among human attacks, the comprehensive lethality of the elbow attack can definitely be ranked among the top three. Jumping down, the target was He Feng.
